product_one_liner.value: Kojo is a materials procurement and inventory management platform that helps trade and self-perform general contractors manage purchasing and materials from takeoff through closeout.
product_one_liner.notes: Kojo describes a materials and inventory platform for trade and self-perform general contractors, connecting teams and managing procurement through project closeout.

pricing_page.notes: Kojo has a public page headed Pricing that describes included features and a custom-quote model.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Kojo’s customer-stories index explicitly lists Cardinal Civil Contracting and Lawson Mechanical Contractors as customer stories. | named_customers.0: The customer story is explicitly for Cardinal Civil Contracting and describes its use of Kojo. | named_customers.1: The customer-stories index identifies Lawson Mechanical Contractors and links to its Kojo case study.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 163 employees, which falls in the 101-200 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile gives Kojo’s locality as San Francisco, California. | hq_country: The company profile identifies Kojo’s country as the United States and its locality as San Francisco, California.

founded_year.notes: Kojo’s LinkedIn company profile states that it was founded in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: Kojo’s engineering publication surfaced a single engineering article, “Rebranding to Kojo,” dated October 27, 2022, and its index says that was the last publication; it does not meet the requirement for at least two product-building posts.

public_docs.notes: Kojo provides a public API documentation portal and multiple substantive articles, including GraphQL and pagination documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official careers page lists only Demand Gen Lead and Revenue Operations Support Analyst; neither title is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.value: OpenAI's GPT-4 and Hugging Face transformer models
model_provider.notes: Kojo’s announcement for its Intelligence Layer explicitly names OpenAI GPT-4 and Hugging Face transformer models.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Kojo’s security page publicly says it successfully completed the SOC 2 audit, supporting the SOC 2 entry. | compliance_certs.0: The security page explicitly reports successful completion of the SOC 2 audit.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The announcement identifies the financing as an extension to Kojo’s Series C round. | funding_date: The funding announcement is dated October 16, 2025, which is YYYY-MM 2025-10. | funding_amount_usd: The October 16, 2025 funding announcement says Wesco invested $10 million in Kojo’s Series C extension.

raised_18mo.notes: Kojo’s $10 million Series C extension was announced on October 16, 2025, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official careers page lists two openings, Demand Gen Lead and Revenue Operations Support Analyst, with no SDR, BDR, sales representative, business development representative, or account executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: Kojo announced Supplier Integrations and a new multi-warehouse-location feature in November 2026; both are inside the six-month window ending November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Profiles show Micah Rodman starting as Co-Founder & CEO and Maria Davidson starting as Founder & Executive Chairman in January 2026, within the preceding 12 months.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Kojo Revenue Operations job description states that Sales and Customer Success use Salesforce. | crm_stack_signal.0: The Kojo job description explicitly names Salesforce as the CRM used by Sales and Customer Success.
